_comment: Category registry for prompt-injection rule categories. Adding a new category = JSON edit + advisory severity rule. CI loader rejects rules referencing unknown category. See SOURCING.md.

instruction_override.friendly_explanation: This text tries to make your AI assistant ignore the rules it follows to keep you safe.

role_confusion.friendly_name: Pretending the AI is a different system
role_confusion.friendly_explanation: This text tries to convince your AI assistant it is a different program with different rules.

system_prompt_extraction.friendly_name: Trying to read AI's hidden instructions
system_prompt_extraction.friendly_explanation: This text tries to make your AI assistant reveal its private setup instructions.

exfiltration.friendly_name: Trying to send your data somewhere else
exfiltration.friendly_explanation: This text could cause your AI assistant to send your private information to a website you don't control.

tool_manipulation.friendly_explanation: This text tries to redirect or interfere with the tools your AI assistant uses.

mcp_manipulation.friendly_explanation: This text tries to alter or hijack the servers your AI tools rely on.

command_execution.friendly_name: Trying to run commands on your machine
command_execution.friendly_explanation: This text could cause your AI assistant to run shell commands that affect your system.

self_reference.friendly_explanation: This text mentions the AI processing itself, which can cause infinite loops or runaway behavior.

encoded_injection.friendly_explanation: Suspicious instructions appear to be hidden inside encoded content (e.g., base64) so a casual reader can't see them.

invisible_text.friendly_explanation: This file contains characters that are invisible to humans but readable by AI. Often used to smuggle hidden instructions.
